title: Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan Terms: Lapse, Reinstatement and Termination
content:
**Lapse.** A Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan lapses when a protection fee is still unpaid the level's lapse period, in calendar days, after its billing date. A plan may be lapsed only when the handling date is not earlier than the billing date of the oldest unpaid protection fee plus the lapse period. Day counts start the day after the anchor date, and the action is allowed on the day the count is reached.

**Losses while lapsed.** Losses that occur while the plan is lapsed are not covered, even after reinstatement.

**Reinstatement.** A lapsed plan is reinstated when every past-due fee is paid, provided the payment comes not later than the lapse date plus the level's reinstatement window in calendar days; coverage resumes from the reinstatement date. The window is counted in the same way: day counts start the day after the lapse date, and the last day of the window is included.

**Termination.** A lapsed plan that is not reinstated inside the window, and any plan whose covered rental is vacated or sold at lien sale, is terminated, effective the window's last day or the rental's move-out date.

## Clock table

| Gate | Clock starts the day after | Comparison | Boundary day |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Lapse | the billing date of the oldest unpaid protection fee (from the fee ledger) | handling date not earlier than anchor plus lapse period | the day the count is reached: lapse allowed |
| Reinstatement | the lapse date on the plan record | payment not later than anchor plus reinstatement window | the last day of the window: reinstatement allowed |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- *Lapse, lapse period of 30 days.* The oldest unpaid fee was billed on day 0. On day 29 the plan may not be lapsed; on day 30 it may.
- *Reinstatement, window of 60 days.* A plan lapsed on day 0. Every past-due fee paid on day 60 reinstates it, with coverage resuming from the reinstatement date; payment on day 61 comes too late, and the plan is terminated effective the window's last day.
- *Loss during the lapse.* A loss on a day the plan was lapsed is not covered, even though the plan is later reinstated.
